meta.name: geniml
meta.description: Use Geniml for audited local genomic-interval workflows: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, inspect model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 校验基因组区间文件，规划并检查嵌入模型训练流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要质检基因组区间数据并规划模型训练流程
copy.tagline_en: Validate genomic interval files and plan embedding model training runs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quality checks on genomic interval data and model run planning

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 geniml 处理 BED 基因组区间数据：校验 BED 与 universe 契约、规划 Region2Vec 或 scEmbed 训练、检查模型与分词器兼容性、评估共识 universe。
howto.when: 当你用 BED 文件做机器学习任务时触发——例如训练区域嵌入、分析单细胞 ATAC-seq 数据、构建共识峰 universe。

say.text: 用 Region2Vec 训练这批 BED 文件的区域嵌入
say.note: 会给出分词、训练、评估步骤

say.text: 用这份 scATAC 数据训练 scEmbed 并做细胞聚类
say.note: 产出细胞嵌入并接入 scanpy 聚类

say.text: 用覆盖度截断法构建 universe 并评估质量
say.note: 生成 universe.bed 并给出评估结果

howto.what_en: Geniml makes Claude work on BED genomic-interval data: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, inspect model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you do machine learning on BED files — training region embeddings, analyzing single-cell ATAC-seq, or building consensus peak universes.

say_en.text: Train Region2Vec embeddings on these BED files
Train scEmbed on this scATAC data and cluster cells
Build a universe with coverage cutoff and evaluate it
